_comment: Illustrative tip record for scripts/kie_wash_phase3.py. A live run writes manifest.out.json next to --out (parent directory) with these asset fields and no _comment: skill_id, slot, index, path, sha256, model, task_id, source. sha256 here is hashlib.sha256 of the ascii labels 643-example-cover and 643-example-example, not image bytes. source is sha256 of the input source_url. task_id values are placeholders. Source URLs are not stored.
